stories.title: ‘Everyone’s Bear’: Colorado zoo grizzly bear dies at 22
stories.summary: Cheyenne Mountain Zoo mourns the loss of Emmett, a 22-year-old grizzly bear, whose gentle nature and unique behaviors touched the lives of many.

stories.title: Avalanche are back on KTVD: Here's how to watch the Canadiens game for free
stories.summary: Catch the Colorado Avalanche face off against the Montreal Canadiens on Wednesday night, with free over-the-air coverage starting at 7 p.m. on KTVD for local viewers.

stories.title: Cheyenne Police mourn loss of retired K9
stories.summary: The Cheyenne Police Department mourns the loss of retired K9 Maverick, whose six-year service saw over 300 citations, nearly 200 arrests.

stories.title: 'Inactive for the game': Steelers benching Aaron Rodgers for Broncos game
stories.summary: Four-time NFL MVP Aaron Rodgers has been benched by the Pittsburgh Steelers and Mason Rudolph will start against the Denver Broncos on Friday.

stories.title: Thanksgiving store closures | King Soopers, Safeway, Walmart, Target: What's open and closed?
stories.summary: Thanksgiving alters U.S. shopping hours as major retailers like Walmart and Target close, while some grocery stores operate with reduced hours.

stories.title: Denver enters top 3 for latest first snow amid Thanksgiving week warmth: Is snow in the forecast?
stories.summary: This Thanksgiving, Colorado experiences mild weather with a warming trend, but a weekend storm could bring snow to the mountains and cooler temps.

stories.title: Denver mild and dry Thanksgiving, ahead of weekend storm and mountain snow
stories.summary: Sunshine and 50s for the rest of the week with minimal holiday travel impacts across the state. Saturday, anticipate the arrival of the next mountain snowstorm

stories.title: Lafayette fences off multiple sites after discovery of another human bone fragment
stories.summary: Local historians are questioning the city's decision to relocate soil containing potential human remains without thoroughly sifting through it.

stories.title: 1 man egging Waymo's robot rideshares around metro, police report says
stories.summary: The man stops his vehicle in front of the Waymo, traps the vehicle with cones, throws eggs at it, then leaves it trapped, a Denver Police Department report says.

stories.title: Aurora to spend $23 million to buy 2 farms, 170 miles away, for water rights
stories.summary: Aurora said the families will keep farming under a lease. A water district in the Arkansas Valley said questions remain about who controls the water.

stories.title: Missing hiker dies in fall from Humboldt Peak
stories.summary: The body of an overdue hiker was found on the north side of the peak just before 1 p.m. Tuesday, according to Custer County Search and Rescue.

stories.title: Colorado SNAP enrollment drops amid new eligibility hurdles
stories.summary: SNAP participation in Colorado dropped 5% from July 2025 to June 2026 due to eligibility changes, leaving 34,000 without federal food aid.
